# LondraDepo.com

> UK warehousing, e-commerce fulfilment, customs coordination, pick & pack, and UK distribution services for Turkish and international businesses. Warehouse located in Rayleigh, Essex (near London). Primary language: Turkish. Contact: WhatsApp +44 7554 195190.

LondraDepo helps businesses — especially Turkish exporters and e-commerce brands — sell into the UK without setting up their own UK operation. Services cover the full logistics chain from UK customs onwards: goods receiving, pallet and carton storage, inventory management, order picking, packing, labelling, Shopify and Amazon FBM fulfilment, and UK distribution.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Physical location: Arterial Park, Arterial Road, Rayleigh, Essex, UK (approximately 40–50 km from central London)
- Warehouse management system: Mintsoft WMS (third-party software, not owned by LondraDepo)
- LondraDepo does NOT handle international freight from Turkey to UK — services begin from UK customs onward
- Customs offering is coordination/support only, not licensed customs brokerage
- No official Shopify or Amazon partnership — fulfilment is independent third-party service
- All pricing is bespoke — no published rates; contact via WhatsApp for quotes
- Turkish-speaking support available
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/447554195190 | Tel: +44 7554 195190
